src/leaderboards/export.rs.description: LeaderboardExporter provides the pattern for export/import: versioned export structs (LeaderboardExport), ImportResult with conflict detection (NameConflict), ConflictResolution enum, and ExportError for error handling. Uses Arc<Database> for db access.

src/storage/schema.rs.description: Database tables for profile export: 'riders' (display_name, avatar_id, bio, ftp, stats), 'avatars' (jersey_color, bike_style, helmet_color), 'ftp_estimates' (ftp_watts, method, confidence, detected_at, accepted).

src/world/avatar.rs.description: AvatarConfig struct with jersey_color ([u8;3]), bike_style (BikeStyle enum), jersey_secondary (Option), helmet_color (Option). Already has Serialize/Deserialize derives.

src/social/export.rs.description: ProfileExporter.import_from_file(path, resolution) reads JSON export file, parses it with version validation, and imports profile data using the specified conflict resolution strategy. Returns ProfileImportResult with counts of imported/skipped FTP entries and update flags for profile/avatar.

src/ui/screens/rider_profile.rs.description: RiderProfileAction enum now includes ImportProfile variant. Import button triggers file picker via parent component (same pattern as LeaderboardScreen.ImportJson and RouteImportScreen.BrowseFiles). UI screens return actions, parent handles file dialogs.
